Package dayplanner

Class ActivityList

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<E>
java.util.AbstractList<Activity>
dayplanner.ActivityList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Activity>, Collection<Activity>, List<Activity>
public class ActivityList extends AbstractList<Activity>
Represents a collection of Activities. Implementation of standard arrays, with some helpful methods.

  • Method Details

    • toRAS

      public String toRAS()
      Encodes this instance into RAS (Readable Activity Serial), a text format that allows it to be written to text files. RAS lists follow the following format: 
      <entry...>
      <entry...>
      <entry...>
      where <entry...> is one single RAS entry (which represents one activity). For more details, see Activity.toRAS() or README.md.
      Returns:
      A RAS representation of this ActivityList.

    • saveToRAS

      public boolean saveToRAS(String dirName, String fileName)
      Attempt to save the ActivityList to the specified file in RAS format. Overwrites any existing content in the file.
      Parameters:
      dirName - Name of the directory where the file will be saved.
      fileName - Name of the file where content will be saved.
      Returns:
      Boolean indicating if the operation succeeded. (true = success, false = failure)
